newsitem.title: INDIA: Indian metals' mixed as world copper rallies.
newsitem.headline: Indian metals' mixed as world copper rallies.

text.p: Indian copper prices extended gains on Tuesday on the back of a world market rally but other metals either fell or were unchanged, dealers said.
Ready copper rose by 200 rupees to 12,100 rupees amidst restricted imports and renewed speculative buying.
Aluminium rose by 25 rupees to 7,225. Tin and nickel on the other hand attracted fresh offerings against continuing supplies. Tin fell by 100 rupees to 34,000 while nickel slumped by 300 to 36,500.
Zinc and lead were unchanged at 6,375 rupees and 4,600, respectively.
